recommendations.recommendation: Pursue less but better: focus on the vital few things and deliberately drop the trivial many.
recommendations.rationale: Doing a few things well makes the highest contribution, while doing more spreads you thin.
recommendations.argued_against: Non-essentialism, trying to do it all

recommendations.recommendation: Know that you can choose what to do; you are not forced to accept every demand.
recommendations.rationale: People who forget they have choice become victims of others' agendas.

recommendations.recommendation: Make time to explore and think; give yourself space for reflection and play.
recommendations.rationale: Space reveals what matters and supports creativity and judgment.

recommendations.recommendation: Escape to a quiet place regularly to think and decide what is essential.
recommendations.rationale: Stepping away from noise gives clarity about what to pursue.

recommendations.recommendation: Look for the true trade-offs and ask what you are willing to give up.
recommendations.rationale: Everything has a cost, so deciding what to sacrifice makes choices deliberate.

recommendations.recommendation: Use strict criteria: say yes only if the opportunity is a definite yes, otherwise treat it as no.
recommendations.rationale: Strict filters stop trivial opportunities from taking over your time.

recommendations.recommendation: Learn to say no gracefully and firmly, without apologizing excessively.
recommendations.rationale: Saying no costs short-term awkwardness, but protects your priorities and earns respect.

recommendations.recommendation: Stop sunk-cost thinking and admit mistakes so you can cut your losses.
recommendations.rationale: Clinging to past investment keeps you committed to the wrong things.

recommendations.recommendation: Edit your commitments by cutting what is not valuable, as an editor removes words.
recommendations.rationale: Cutting makes room for the essential.

recommendations.recommendation: Remove obstacles to the essential, finding the biggest constraint and clearing it.
recommendations.rationale: Removing the obstacle is easier than pushing harder and yields more progress.

recommendations.recommendation: Start small and reward progress, aiming for small wins instead of grand launches.
recommendations.rationale: Small steps build momentum more reliably than big pushes.

recommendations.recommendation: Build routines that make essentials automatic, and protect the assets of body and sleep.
recommendations.rationale: Routines save energy, and sleep and health support better judgment and creativity.

recommendations.recommendation: Be present in the moment and focus on what is important right now.
recommendations.rationale: Presence cuts through distraction and brings clarity.
